The residual is orthogonal to x; replacing one vector of y produces a zero-column determinant for x and an identity-column determinant equal to inner ℝ (y i) e for y. The assumed equality forces this value to vanish, hence e = 0 and y i belongs to span x. The n = 0 case is vacuous. Matrix.of and the explicitly typed identity have the intended matrix meaning. The proof is complete and independent of both the other child and the parent; the bare lean_name is fresh.
